Name: Pets Enhanced - A Pet Mechanic Overhaul
Author: SunkenLace
Description:
[b][size=3]This mod is currently compatible with all mod packs out there, as such, feel free to include it into your collection![/size]
[color=#d8d8d8][size=2]This mod is also compatible with expansion maps and is able to interact with them no problem.
[/size][/color]

[size=5]What's new?[/size][/b]
[size=3]- [color=#ffe599]New[/color] items sold at [b][color=#e06666]Marnie's Shop[/color][/b]:
﻿- [/size]A Pet Manual(Non-consumable)      [ Price: [color=#ffe599]7000g[/color] ]
﻿- Dog Treats(Consumable)                  [ Price: [color=#ffe599]30g[/color] ]
﻿- Cat Treats(Consumable)                   [ Price: [color=#ffe599]30g[/color] ]
﻿ ﻿- Crunchy Treats(Consumable)                   [ Price: [color=#ffe599]30g[/color] ]
﻿- Pet Backpack(Consumable)              [ Price: [color=#ffe599]3000g[/color] ]

- [b][color=#fce5cd][size=3]Pet Flute[/size][/color] [/b][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]added[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]!
[/size][spoiler] ﻿[size=2]Once you reach 5 hearts with a pet, Marnie will send you an item through the mail.
[/size][size=2] ﻿This item is called a Pet Flute, this tool allows you to call your pet from anywhere, as long as you have at least one fully trained pet.[/size][/spoiler][/color]
[size=3]- [color=#ffe599]New[/color] Trick Learning Mechanic for Pets(Cats and Dogs):
[/size][spoiler] ﻿[size=2]Click on your pet with a "Pet Manual" in your hand to unlock your pet's hidden potential.
﻿Use your "Pet Manual" again on your pet to teach it new tricks.
﻿An UI will appear in front of you. Choose one of the multiple options available (each of them will cost a certain amount of "Treats").
﻿After choosing one of the options, your pet will make a certain amount of progress at the lesson chosen.
Once a lesson has reached 100%, your pet will be able to perform the trick you've taught it.[/size][/spoiler]
[size=3]- Mechanic: [b][color=#ffe599]Follow[/color][/b][/size]
[size=2]Your pet will follow you anywhere (except at events, cuz they're player-exclusive).
﻿(You can have up to 3 pets following you at the same time)
[/size]
[size=3]- Mechanic: [color=#e06666][b]Hunt[/b][/color][/size]
[size=2]Your pet will follow you and attack any monster they deem "Huntable".
﻿Pet damage scales with its hunting skill mastery and base stats.
[/size]
[size=3]- [color=#f4f4f4]([/color][color=#f9cb9c][b]Dog Only[/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4])[/color]Mechanic: [/size][color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Forage[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2][color=#f4f4f4]Your pet will follow you and search in any nearby bushes for forage.
[/color][/size]
[size=3]- [color=#f4f4f4]([/color][b][color=#6d9eeb]Cat Only[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4])[/color]Mechanic: [/size][color=#00ffff][size=3][b]Fishing[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2][color=#f4f4f4]Your pet will go to the nearest water source and fish once it sees viable fishing spot (bubbles on water), then it will pick up the fish if it fits into its inventory.
[/color][/size]
[size=3]- Mechanic: [/size][color=#d9d2e9][size=3][b]Wait[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2][color=#f4f4f4]Your pet will sit down and wait for you on the spot until you tell it to stop.
﻿The pet will also passively recover its energy as time passes.[/color][/size]

[size=3]- Now you can [b][color=#fff2cc]gift[/color][/b] "treats" to your pets to increase their [color=#ea9999][b]friendship[/b][/color] more quickly or to replenish their energy bar.
[/size][color=#d8d8d8]    Upon giving a treat to a pet, the item will appear inside the Diet List Scroll (Gift icon inside the Status Window); There you can see some simplified information about the item.[/color]

[color=#efefef][size=3]- Your pet will increase their mastery over a skill the more it performs it. Higher mastery means unlocking skill perks (which provides various benefits).[/size][/color]

- [size=3]You can obtain [b][color=#ffd966]Pet Collars[/color][/b] (which provides different[color=#f1c232] buffs[/color]) by leveling up your farmer skills (you'll receive the recipe via mail or in Marnie's shop once you fulfill the unlock conditions).

Buffs added by Pet Collars:
[list]
[*][color=#d8d8d8][size=3]Rough collar: +25% attack buff +10% crit chance (Single pet)[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8][size=3]Lightweight collar: +4% speed buff (player) -15% attack cooldown (Single pet, combat).[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8][size=3]Luxury collar:  25% chance to re-roll product quality chances (All pets, fishing, foraging). 10% chance to get double loot when foraging or fishing (All pets).[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8][size=3]Flowery collar: +15% chance to find products when foraging (Single pet). +10% chance to get quality products when foraging (Single pet). Greatly reduces chances to get trash (single pet).[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8][size=3]Seagoing collar: +20% chance to find products when fishing (Single pet). Increases chances of getting better fish (Single pet), greatly reduces chances to get trash (Single pet).[/size][/color]
[/list][/size] ﻿
[size=5][b]
Installation Instructions
[/b][/size][size=3]- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[size=3]- Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url][size=3]﻿ along with its requirements.[/size]
[size=3]- Extract this mod into your mod folder. Usually at [i]..[/i][i]\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.
[/i]- Enjoy![/size]



[size=3]Mods that were specially made compatible are:[/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d8d8d8]Pets On Hats Plus: Any mod that uses this framework will now be able to see their settings reflected on the mod.[/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8]Player Backpack Upgrade mods: Mods that use this mechanic are visually and functionally compatible with the pet inventory system.[/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8]Alternative Textures: Any mod that uses this framework will now be able to see their settings reflected on the mod. However, AT scissors cannot interact with pets currently following a player.[/color]
[*][color=#d8d8d8]QuickSave (Save Midday): Users will now be able to quick save/load pet progress. [/color]
[/list]
[color=#e06666][size=5][b]Important
[/b][b]------------[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Be aware that this mod is not compatible with Android.[/b]
[*][color=#cccccc][size=3]Adding mods that seek a similar concept as this mod might cause some visual bugs, but they are compatible.[/size][/color]
[*][color=#cccccc][size=3]In case of misplaced hat positions on modded pets check if the mod you're adding has any form of hat placement configuration (be it Hats on Pets Plus or a Content pack for this mod)[/size][/color]
[/list]
